title: Hamming distance and support size
statement:
Let $u$ and $v$ be words of length $n$ over a finite alphabet $\alpha$, so each is a function from $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$ to $\alpha$. Their Hamming distance equals the number of coordinates where they differ:
\[
d(u,v)=\#\{i\in\mathrm{Fin}\,n:u(i)\ne v(i)\}.
\]
replaced:
Let $u,v$ be words of length $n$ over a finite alphabet $\alpha$, that is, functions
$\mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \alpha$. Then the Hamming distance between them equals the number
of coordinates on which they differ:
\[
d(u,v) = \abs{\{i \in \mathrm{Fin}\,n : u_i \ne v_i\}}.
\]
